essence: In all other cases, a specific measure is prescribed for the foot-end.
Beginning from one and a half aṅgulas, the measure should be increased by half a mātrā.
The wall should be constructed according to strength and beauty.
The previously stated divisions are declared not to exceed nine in length.
Lion-form figures should be made on the foot, between feet, or elsewhere.
